Per the dental-to-dental direction, imaging is NOT pushed with this referral — Austin Oral Surgery retrieves it via CDex support-a-pull using the ImagingStudy reference in supportingInfo (which points to a DICOM WADO-RS endpoint), same pattern for the periodontal charting and intraoral images.
